visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A small child with dark pigtails wearing a white swimsuit with orange citrus patterns sits on a sunny, golden sand beach. Beside her, an adult male in a green shirt and brown shorts is visible from the waist down, also playing in the sand. (2) The camera zooms in on the child's face as she looks down intently at her feet, which are partially buried under a mound of wet sand. Her hands are covered in sand as she pats the pile. (3) A small ocean wave surges onto the shore, the white foam washing over the child's legs and dissolving the sand pile she had built. The child looks up at the camera with a wide-eyed, stunned facial expression. (4) The child begins rebuilding the sand pile over her legs with renewed energy, using both hands to scoop dry sand. The background shows other beachgoers and umbrellas under a clear, bright sky. (5) The child turns her attention to the person filming, whose legs are visible in the foreground. She begins patting sand onto the adult's legs while murmuring. (6) A final pink screen appears with a 2D cartoon animation of the child and the text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE".
